components.name: Primary Button (business flood)
components.description: The one action per screen that advances the game; flooded in the business colour.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 260px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); font: 350 17px/1.4 Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .14s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .14s; } .ds-btn svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--biz, #C2410C); border-color: var(--biz, #C2410C); color: #fff; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); font: 350 17px/1.4 Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .14s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .14s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); color: var(--bg, #FFFFFF); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; font-family: Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile { background: var(--card, #F1F1F1); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); min-height: 116px; padding: 12px 14px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; border-radius: 0; } .ds-val { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-lbl { font-size: 15px; margin-top: 8px; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); text-transform: lowercase; min-height: 1.3em; } .ds-meter { height: 4px; background: var(--line, #DADADA); margin-top: 10px; } .ds-meter i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); } .ds-tile-good { background: #1E7A34; color: #fff; } .ds-tile-good .ds-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,.86); }

components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; font-family: Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button { background: var(--card, #F1F1F1); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px; min-height: 92px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: transform .14s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-seg b { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 300; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-seg span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); margin-top: 4px; } .ds-seg button.on { background: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); color: var(--bg, #FFFFFF); } .ds-seg button.on span { color: inherit; opacity: .72; } .ds-seg button:active { transform: scale(.94); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-stepper { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); } .ds-stepper button { width: 56px; min-height: 56px; background: var(--card, #F1F1F1); color: inherit; border: 0; border-radius: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .14s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-stepper svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-stepper button:active { transform: scale(.94); } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-v { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1; } .ds-v small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); margin-top: 4px; text-transform: lowercase; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square transparent field, 2px line border turning ink on focus, label lowercase muted.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 616px; font-family: Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-field input { font: 300 24px/1.4 inherit; font-family: inherit; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #DADADA); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline: none; caret-color: var(--biz, #C2410C); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); }

components.css: .ds-pivot { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 18px; font-family: Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pivot button { min-height: 40px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); text-transform: lowercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pivot button:hover { color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); } .ds-pivot button.on { color: var(--accent, #C2410C); } .ds-pivot button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-band { width: 100%; background: var(--card, #F1F1F1); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0C); padding: 36px 24px 32px; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.35); font-family: Selawik, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; animation: ds-band .36s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } @keyframes ds-band { from { transform: translateY(16px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } } .ds-band h2 { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: lowercase; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-band p { color: var(--muted, #5E5E5E); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; max-width: 60ch; } .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 28px; } .ds-b { flex: 1; max-width: 240px; min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 350 17px/1.4 inherit; font-family: inherit; text-transform: lowercase; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-b-primary { background: var(--biz, #C2410C); border-color: var(--biz, #C2410C); color: #fff; } .ds-b:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0B0B0C); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The business is drawn as flat colour tiles and giant lowercase type on a plain black or white ground. Numbers live in tiles; when the player opens the next week, the six stat tiles flip over in a staggered wave and come back with the new values. Headings are not boxes around content: a 40px light lowercase word is the container. Everything is square, borderless and unshadowed, so state is carried entirely by fills: the business colour floods exactly one thing (the "open next week" tile), and profit or loss floods its tile green or red.

The world refuses the cream-card-serif dashboard: no soft cards, no rounded corners, no serif display, no drop-shadowed panels. Density comes from typographic scale contrast (148px name against 13px captions), not from chrome. Personality lives in the motion (the flip, the heading flash, the band pop-up) and in the lowercase voice, while the numbers stay clear and trustworthy.

The visual identity is game-wide. A business type contributes only its colour (`--biz`, set at runtime from theme data) and nothing else; every rule here must hold for any business colour that keeps white text readable.
keyCharacteristics: Black or white ground, light-grey or near-black tiles, no radius anywhere.
Selawik Light, lowercase for every display and label string; body copy stays sentence case.
One flooded business-colour tile per screen; green/red floods mean state, never decoration.
Thin square-capped SVG strokes for every icon.
Depth only on the pop-up band.
Light and dark are equal citizens (auto / light / dark toggle).

rules.name: The One Flood Rule
rules.body: The business colour floods exactly one tile per screen: the action that advances time. Everything else that is selected floods in ink, not in the business colour.

rules.name: The Floods Are State Rule
rules.body: Green and red fills appear only when a value says so (profit, loss, a failing metric). They are never used to decorate or to group.

rules.name: The Derived Accent Rule
rules.body: `--accent` is computed from `--biz`, never set by a theme. The "fair" price state is neutral (`--muted`), not a third accent hue.

rules.name: The Variables Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from a CSS custom property defined for light and dark.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Every display and label string is lowercase (headings, tile labels, buttons, pills, captions, table headers), applied with `text-transform` so source strings stay sentence case. Body copy (tips, pop-up text, notes) stays sentence case.

rules.name: The Label Under Rule
rules.body: A label sits under its value, never above it. Tiles order value, meter, label, sub; the company value and cash put their caption beneath the figure. No eyebrows or kickers.

rules.name: The Light Figure Rule
rules.body: Large numbers are weight 300 with -0.02em tracking; never bold a figure to make it important, make it bigger.

rules.name: The Only The Band Rule
rules.body: No shadows anywhere except the pop-up band. If something needs to stand out, flood it or make it bigger.

rules.name: The Struck Through Rule
rules.body: Locked content (themes not yet available, menu items and upgrades not yet unlocked) is shown by a 1px line-through in muted colour, not a padlock or a dimmed card.

dos: **Do** keep every display and label string lowercase via `text-transform`, and leave body copy in sentence case.
**Do** put labels and captions under their values.
**Do** flood the business colour on exactly one tile per screen, the action that advances time; flood selections in ink.
**Do** use profit-green and loss-red fills only to report state.
**Do** draw minus, plus, arrows and checks as thin square-capped SVG strokes in `currentColor`.
**Do** derive `--accent` from `--biz` (light: `var(--biz)`; dark: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--biz) 62%, #fff)`), and define every new colour variable for both light and dark.
**Do** keep touch targets at least 40px (buttons 48px, steppers 56px), and never put anything important behind hover; keyboard hints are hidden on touch devices.
**Do** mark locked things with a 1px muted line-through.
donts: **Don't** add shadows outside the pop-up band.
**Don't** put eyebrows or kickers above headings or values.
**Don't** use text glyphs or emoji as icons.
**Don't** let a theme add design beyond its business colour and icons.
**Don't** give the "fair" price state a colour; it is neutral muted.
**Don't** bold figures for emphasis; scale them in light weight.
**Don't** drift back to the cream-card-serif dashboard: no soft cards, no serif display, no rounded panels.
